description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_EN: Some HSR trains will not stop at Humen Station

2026-11-21T16:06:00.CONTENT_EN: As informed by the Chinese Mainland Railway Authorities, the following trains will not stop at Humen Station between 24 November and 27 December because of scheduling arrangements. Ticket sales to and from Humen Station are suspended for these trips. From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station G388, G904, G928, G6048/5, G6508, G6516, G6530, G6534, G6536, G6538, G6580 To Hong Kong West Kowloon Station G6046/7, G6511, G6515, G6517, G6527, G6529, G6531, G6533, G6539 For the latest arrangement, please refer to the 12306 official website or mobile app, or the High Speed Rail website or mobile app.
